scenes.title: DROP EVEREST IN THE OCEAN
scenes.say: If you dropped Mount Everest into the deepest part of the ocean, its peak would still be more than two kilometres under water.

scenes.title: THE LAST WATER ON EARTH
scenes.say: It's called the Challenger Deep, in the Mariana Trench. NOAA puts it at about 10,935 metres deep. Drain the ocean six kilometres, and this is where the last water would be.
